overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The main issues were: (1) including non-NLG evaluation metrics (accuracy, F1, RMSE) that were used for scoring classification, not text generation evaluation; (2) listing human evaluation criteria that were only suggested for future work but not actually implemented. The paper clearly addresses NLG through elaborated feedback generation and uses standard NLG evaluation metrics.
